Founded in 1863 by John A., a well-to-do shoemaker from England, and family-run until 1945, products have a long and illustrious history. boots were worn by soldiers on both sides of America's Civil War, soldiers in the Spanish-American war, and by Teddy Roosevelt and his Rough Riders.

When homesteading drew adventurous New England families to the West during the mid and late 1800's many of the pioneers wore Boots for the long journey.
